identity.vibe: Premium, trustworthy, scalable, modern India-first enterprise.
identity.theme: Light mode only (dark mode fallbacks defined but light is primary).
identity.inspiration: Linear (precision/borders), Stripe (shadows/typography), Notion (clean white space), Odoo/Zoho (functional density).
identity.core_concept: Avoid generic 'AI slop' blue/purple. Use a grounded, wealthy 'Obsidian Pine' and 'Terracotta' palette reflecting GLC's diverse verticals (Fresh, Property, Jewellery).

sidebar.spec: Floating sidebar. Width: 260px. Left margin: 16px. Top/Bottom margin: 16px. Radius: 16px (rounded-2xl). Background: white. Border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05). Shadow: 'float'. Active item: bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 font-medium.

topbar.spec: Sticky top navigation. Height: 64px. Background: bg-white/70. Blur: backdrop-blur-xl. Border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border). Padding-left: 292px (to accommodate floating sidebar). Features: Global Search Command Palette (Cmd+K) button, Vertical Switcher Dropdown, Profile.

card.spec: Radius: 16px to 20px (rounded-2xl or rounded-[20px]). Background: pure white. Border: 1px solid var(--border). Shadow: sm or md. Padding: p-5 or p-6.

data_grid.spec: Row height: 44px (dense but breathable). Header: sticky top-0, bg-slate-50/80 backdrop-blur-sm, text-xs uppercase text-slate-500. Row hover: bg-slate-50. No zebra stripes (looks dated), use subtle bottom borders (border-b border-slate-100) instead. Cells containing amounts/numbers MUST use font-mono.

kanban.spec: Column background: bg-slate-50/50 rounded-xl. Card: bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-200 cursor-grab.

timeline.spec: Vertical line: w-px bg-slate-200. Marker: 8px dot ringed by 4px white background. Content card: subtle border, rounded-lg. Used in CRM lead history and Audit Logs.

badges.spec: Pill shaped (rounded-full). Height: 24px. Padding: px-2.5 py-0.5. Font: text-xs font-medium. Soft backgrounds (e.g., bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700, bg-amber-50 text-amber-700).

buttons.spec: Slightly rounded (rounded-lg or rounded-xl). Primary: bg-[#064E3B] hover:bg-[#064E3B]/90 text-white. Secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50. Transition: transform 0.1s ease, active:scale-[0.98].

skeleton_loaders.spec: Subtle pulsing bg-slate-100 rounded-md. Avoid high-contrast blinking.

layouts.dashboard: Top: 4 KPI Cards (white, subtle shadow, mono numbers). Middle: 2 Col Grid (Col-span-8: Revenue Area Chart, Col-span-4: Sales by Vertical Donut). Bottom: Recent Activity table.
layouts.crm_pipeline: Horizontal scrollable flex container. 4-5 columns (Lead, Contacted, Qualified, Proposal, Won). Draggable cards.
layouts.customer_360: 2-Column Split. Left (Col 4): Profile Card + Contact Info + Tags. Right (Col 8): Tabs (Timeline, Transactions, Support Tickets, Documents).
layouts.invoice_generator: White paper-like card (max-w-4xl mx-auto, shadow-lg, p-12). Top: GLC Logo + Company details. Grid for line items. Bottom: Total calculations and Tax breakup (CGST/SGST).

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly ONLY on the sticky topbar, sticky table headers, and overlay dialogs/modals (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/60). Never on standard cards.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React. Use a consistent stroke width (1.5px) and size (18px for nav, 16px for buttons).
visual_enhancers.charts: Recharts. Use responsive containers. Tooltips must be glassmorphic with sharp borders. Use smooth curves for line/area charts (type='monotone').

hero_empty_states.description: Abstract data illustration for empty dashboard or setup states

avatars.description: Premium professional headshot for topbar profile

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICTLY read and apply the css variables and tailwind classes mapped in this document.
DO NOT use generic blue or purple primary colors. The brand color is 'Deep Pine/Obsidian Green' (#064E3B).
Ensure all numerical data (currency, percentages, IDs) uses 'font-mono' for alignment.
Implement the floating sidebar as specified (w-64, m-4, rounded-2xl). The main content area must account for this offset.
For the multi-vertical switcher, use a Shadcn DropdownMenu in the Topbar with a distinctive visual style.
Do not add heavy borders or heavy shadows. Keep it light, airy, and high-contrast.
Use Recharts for all graphs. Apply the custom 'chart_palette' provided in this JSON.
Every page must have an empty state if no data is present, featuring a Lucide icon and a subtle CTA.
Use framer-motion for subtle entrance animations (e.g., initial={opacity:0, y:10} animate={opacity:1, y:0}) on cards and page loads.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Ensure UI is accessible (APCA/WCAG contrast ratios) and supports keyboard navigation.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than default. E.g., Use gap-6 or gap-8 instead of gap-4 for grids.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.transitions: DO NOT use 'transition: all'. Explicitly define properties like 'transition-colors' or 'transition-transform'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.alignment: Left-align text by default. Never apply text-align: center globally.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.components: Prioritize Shadcn UI. Override default Shadcn border radius to match the 16-20px spec where appropriate.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toast: Use 'sonner' for toasts. Position them at bottom-right.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing: All key elements MUST have data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
